item: Timer wheel drops a node with no expiry but leaves the entry's pointer to it (use-after-free)
note: Node freed without unset_timer_node; later deschedule runs unlink_timer and drop on freed memory

item: Reordered write ops admit removed entries, leaving phantom entries and inflated count/weight
note: handle_upsert admits without checking the map or policy_gen; removal before upsert leaks it

item: Shared policy_weight is overwritten before the CAS commits, so weighted_size drifts
note: new_value_entry_from sets the shared EntryInfo weight; a retry or another thread reads it

item: MiniArc last-reference drop races with other threads' writes
note: Release fetch_sub is followed by fence(Acquire) before freeing, as in std Arc

item: SegmentedCache holds more entries than max_capacity
note: Each power-of-two segment gets ceil(max/segments), so the total exceeds the documented max

item: is_old_value_replaced() is false after or_insert_with_if replaces a value
note: Initialized result always builds Entry::new(k, v, true, false), contradicting the docs

item: Unsafe blocks lack SAFETY comments; Send impls have no K: Send bound
note: Documentation only; crate-private types, and constructors require Send + Sync
